messages.subject: mapPies - offsetting piecharts
messages.body_plain:
Apologies if this question has been dealt with elsewhere - I have had a look around and not found any clear suggestions.

Is there a way to offset where the piecharts are mapped using mapPies so that they don't completely cover countries?

I've attached my plot to illustrate the problem (Ireland is a good example).  Script and dummy dataset included below.

Many thanks in advance.

Jamie

>> DATASTRUCTURE
Region Count Category   Positive  Probable    Negative
Ireland       13           B(10-49)     0.384615    0.076923      0.538462

>> SCRIPT

sPDF <- joinCountryData2Map(data, joinCode = "NAME", nameJoinColumn = "Region")

dF <- sPDF@data

par(mai = c(0,0,0.6,0), xaxs = "i", yaxs = "i")

Colours <- c("khaki", "yellow", "darkorange", "firebrick1")
mapCountryData(sPDF, nameColumnToPlot="Category", colourPalette=Colours, mapTitle="Worldwide distribution", xlim=c(-180, 180), ylim=c(-90,90))

par(new=T)
par(mai = c(0,0,0.6,0), xaxs = "i", yaxs = "i")

mapPies(dF=dF, nameX="LON", nameY="LAT", nameZs=c("Positive", "Probable", "Negative"), zColours=c("limegreen", "orange", "red"), addCatLegend=F, mapRegion="world", xlim=c(-180,180), ylim=c(-90,90), symbolSize= 0.3)

legend(-180.1516,0, title="Outcome", legend=c("Positive","Probable","Negative"), col=c("limegreen","orange","red"), pch=16, cex=0.8, pt.cex=1.5, bty="o", box.lty=0, horiz=F, bg="#FFFFFF70")

messages.subject: Re: [rworldmap group] mapPies - offsetting piecharts
messages.body_plain:
Hi Jamie,
Good question !
Excuse quick answer (it's my birthday today and I'm off on holiday for a few days from tomorrow).

Doing something like thus prior to calling mapPies should move the symbol position for that country.
offset <- 3
dF$LON[ dF$ADMIN=='Ireland' ] <- dF$LON[ dF$ADMIN=='Ireland' ] - offset

Let us know how you get on.
Best wishes,
Andy
